Label: Latitude
Description: Latitude of the location where data was collected

Label: Longitude
Description: Longitude of the location where data was collected

Label: Priority Index
Description: PI = CI + WI  where, PI = Priority Index (Hassan Index, %)  CI = Column Index  WI = Wall Index

Label: Total Floor Area
Description: Af: Total areas above ground levels.

Label: Column Area
Description: Acol: Sum of cross-sectional areas of all columns at ground floor

Label: Concrete Wall Area (NS)
Description: cross-sectional areas of reinforced concrete walls in NS direction

Label: Concrete Wall Area (EW)
Description: cross-sectional areas of reinforced concrete walls in EW direction

Label: Masonry Wall Area (NS)
Description: cross-sectional areas of infill masonry walls in NS direction at ground floor

Label: Masonry Wall Area (EW)
Description: cross-sectional areas of infill masonry walls in EW direction at ground floor

Label:
Structural 
Damage
Description: Four classes of Damage  Light: Hairline (crack width not exceeding approximate 0.13 mm) inclined and flexural cracks were observed in structural elements  Moderate: Wider cracks or spalling of concrete were observed.  Severe: At least one element had a structural failure.  Collapse: At least one floor slab or part of it lost its elevation.

Label:
Masonry Wall
Damage
Description: Damage to infill walls classified as follows:  Light: Hairline (crack width not exceeding approximate 0.13 mm) cracks occurred.  Moderate: Wider cracks or larger pieces of plaster flaked off.  Severe: The element collapsed or cracks wide enough to see through the wall appeared.

Label:
Captive
Columns
Description: Are there captive columns? Yes or No

Label:
Column
Index
Description: CI =0.5 Acol /Af *100%  where,  Acol: the sum of cross-sectional areas of all columns at ground floor  Af: total areas above ground areas

Label: Wall Index (NS)
Description: WI = (Acw + 0.1 Amw)/Af *100%  where,  Acw: the sums of cross-sectional areas of reinforced concrete walls in north-south direction at ground floor.  Amw: the sums of cross-sectional areas of infill masonry walls in north-south direction at ground floor.  Af: total areas above ground areas

Label: Wall Index (EW)
Description: WI = (Acw + 0.1 Amw)/Af *100%  where,  Acw: the sums of cross-sectional areas of reinforced concrete walls in east-west direction at ground floor.  Amw: the sums of cross-sectional areas of infill masonry walls in east-west direction at ground floor.  Af: total areas above ground areas.
